user.title: Connect your ViP installation
user.description: Community integration for the native ViP LAN transport, reported working with UT8020 + TP6842. Enter your own network addresses. The slave address must be unused. Start with SIP disabled and configure audio later. The camera is configured separately. Setup guide: {documentation_url}

data.master_port: Master port (initial value; CRP resolves the current port)
data.entrance_port: Entrance port (initial value; CRP resolves the current port)
data.loxone_ip: Loxone IP (only required for doorbell forwarding)
data.sip_allowed_ips: Allowed Loxone app device IPv4 addresses, comma separated
data.remote_auto_enabled: Accept external audio automatically (without an unlock button)

data_description.local_ip: Stable IPv4 address of the HA host on the intercom network.
data_description.crp_broadcast_ip: Broadcast address of your subnet, not the router IP.
data_description.master_ip: TP6842 Ethernet address, not its Wi-Fi address.
data_description.entrance_ip: LAN address of the UT8020 entrance panel.
data_description.source_address: Master address followed by an unused slave digit 1–9. Do not replace an existing monitor.
data_description.entrance_address: Eight-digit ViP address of the entrance panel.
data_description.remote_gateway_key: Only for the optional audio gateway. Not a HA token or SIP password.

error.invalid_config: Check IPv4 addresses, ports and ViP addresses. The slave identity is the master address plus an unused digit 1–9. Enabled SIP needs at least one allowed phone IP.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one native connection is supported.

init.title: Door release and audio
init.description: Local audio uses Loxone directly. For external audio, set the same gateway key (32–128 letters, digits, _ or -) here and in the app. Automatic mode allows the normal Loxone call button to start a conversation without a separate grant. External callers are not authenticated as Loxone users: anyone who knows your Antisip address can call and activate audio. Manual mode requires a one-use grant. One conversation at a time. Changing these options ends an active SIP call.

data.sip_allowed_ips: Allowed Loxone app device IPv4 addresses, comma separated
data.remote_auto_enabled: Accept external audio automatically (without an unlock button)

error.invalid_options: Check relay, SIP port and individual device IPv4 addresses. Gateway key: empty or 32–128 characters from A–Z, a–z, 0–9, _ and -. No spaces.

authorize_remote_audio.name: Authorize remote audio
authorize_remote_audio.description: Allow one external call within 30 seconds. Does not release the door or start a call. Requires a configured audio gateway.
